research_question: How do HBM-to-SMEM data movement and fifth-generation Tensor Core throughput constrain BF16 GEMM performance on NVIDIA GB300, and how closely can the CuTe DSL implementation approach cuBLASLt?

population.pilot_role: orchestration qualification evidence only; excluded from every P4.3 statistic, ranking, variability estimate, table, figure, and conclusion

analysis_provenance.clean_definition: HEAD is one full 40-character commit; the index equals that commit's tree, so nothing is staged; every tracked path exists in the worktree with exactly the committed blob content and mode; no index entry is unmerged, skip-worktree, or intent-to-add; every indexed path is read regardless of assume-unchanged hints; and no merge, rebase, cherry-pick, revert, or bisect is in progress. Untracked content is permitted only below results/raw, results/preflight, and results/phase4; every untracked path elsewhere is rejected. Production also requires Python -I -B isolated mode, preventing checkout, PYTHONPATH, user-site, or bytecode-cache import injection
analysis_provenance.verification_method: pure-Python read of .git: HEAD and refs resolved without a child process, the index's cache-tree root compared to the HEAD commit's tree, and every tracked path's blob SHA-1 and mode recomputed from the worktree; every untracked path outside the three frozen data roots was rejected

bundle_contract.note: analysis_manifest.json is the authoritative binding for this bundle: it records the population, the provenance, and a SHA-256 for each of the other eight artifacts. An individual CSV or SVG is a deterministic data or visual artifact, not a standalone provenance envelope, and must be distributed together with the manifest. This document and report.md carry the scientific context needed to interpret the bundle

definitions.measured_source_observation: a quantity an instrument recorded directly during the campaign, described as measured only where the closed upstream protocol supports that description
definitions.within_campaign_derived_estimate: a deterministic quantity computed inside one campaign from measured inputs and validated constants; reproducible, but not itself measured
definitions.cross_campaign_descriptive_statistic: a descriptive statistic P4.3 computed over exactly three campaign-level values; it describes agreement between campaigns, never a new measurement
definitions.modeled_estimate: a quantity produced by applying a model or a unit conversion to a derived estimate; its status as a model is always stated
definitions.interpretation: a reading of the evidence, phrased as consistent-with rather than as a causal claim
definitions.unavailable_from_collected_evidence: a question the collected evidence cannot answer; reported as such instead of being filled in
definitions.source_diagnostic: a trust signal the closed unit recorded about its own measurement; preserved verbatim and never converted into a result

best_cutedsl_variant.basis: derived within-campaign selection: the fastest of the three CuTe DSL candidates by full-precision kernel time in that campaign

diagnostic_flags.basis: the closed unit's own per-case Nsight Compute diagnostics, e.g. READ_AMPLIFICATION when dram_read_ratio > 1.10; reported, never hidden or normalized away

dram_read_ratio.basis: derived from profiler evidence, not a raw profiler counter: Nsight Compute's dram__bytes_read.sum divided by that case's validated useful_bytes (P1.4 section 5)

earliest_tested_candidate_saturation_bif.basis: derived within-campaign selection over exactly three tested bytes-in-flight values; never a universal HBM saturation threshold

earliest_tested_candidate_saturation_dep.basis: derived within-campaign selection over exactly four tested depths; never a universal architectural saturation depth

estimated_device_equivalent_tflops.basis: modeled whole-device extrapolation: the modeled per-SM microbenchmark estimate multiplied by a validated SM count; never a measured whole-GPU throughput

estimated_tflops_per_sm.basis: modeled clock conversion of a one-/two-SM microbenchmark result: the clock-independent median FLOP/cycle multiplied by that same configuration's own profiled SM clock and divided by cta_group; never an architectural peak

gap_to_cublaslt_pct.basis: derived within-campaign signed gap, 100 * (1 - throughput_ratio); negative means the candidate measured faster and is never clamped

hbm_classification.basis: derived classification of the profiler-derived dram_read_ratio against P1.4's frozen 0.90 rule; not a raw profiler counter

kernel_time_ms.basis: measured input: CUDA-event kernel time on the candidate's own execution stream, divided by the measured iteration count, after correctness passed (P3.5 section 7 step 9)

median_effective_gbps.basis: campaign-level median of 30 timing-derived effective transfer rates; each repetition is the benchmark's logical useful_bytes divided by its own CUDA-event kernel time (P1.1/P1.2: effective copy bandwidth, explicitly NOT HBM/DRAM bandwidth)

median_flops_per_cycle.basis: clock-independent operation-and-cycle-derived throughput: the campaign-level median of total_flops (a validated 2*M*N*K*depth*iterations operation count) divided by the measured %clock64 elapsed_cycles (P2.1/P2.2, P2.4 section 6)

median_flops_per_cycle_per_sm.basis: the same operation-and-cycle-derived throughput divided by the configuration's cta_group; clock-independent, still derived, never directly measured

ncu_coverage.basis: whether this configuration is one of the six frozen Nsight Compute cases; where it is not, actual HBM/DRAM traffic is unavailable from the collected evidence

profile_diagnostic_metrics_resolved_coun.basis: P2.4's terminal per-configuration count of optional profiler diagnostic metrics that were resolved; preserved without inventing a pass threshold

profile_sm_clock_status.basis: P2.4's terminal per-configuration validation status for the profiled SM-clock metric used by modeled clock conversions

scaling_efficiency_percent.basis: derived within-campaign quantity: 100 * speedup_2sm_over_1sm / 2, never clamped to [0, 100]

speedup_2sm_over_1sm.basis: derived within-campaign ratio of two campaign-level median FLOP/cycle values (P2.4 section 6.1); the two configurations execute sequentially, never as paired samples

surprising_value_flag.basis: the closed unit's own diagnostic that a scaling efficiency fell outside [0, 100]; the value itself is preserved unclamped

tflops.basis: derived within-campaign throughput: the exact 2*M*N*K operation count divided by the measured kernel time (P3.5 section 8)

throughput_ratio_vs_cublaslt.basis: derived within-campaign ratio against that campaign's own cuBLASLt baseline row; never recomputed from cross-campaign aggregates

tma_to_ldgsts_ratio.basis: derived within-campaign ratio of the two campaign-level median effective transfer rates at one identical configuration (P1.4 section 6)

within_campaign_cv_percent.basis: the closed unit's own within-campaign coefficient of variation over that campaign's retained repetitions; never the cross-campaign CV

within_campaign_flops_per_cycle_iqr_flag.basis: P2.4's count of retained flops_per_cycle repetitions outside its Tukey IQR fences; diagnostic only, with no sample removal

within_campaign_flops_per_cycle_per_sm_c.basis: P2.4's within-campaign coefficient of variation for the retained flops_per_cycle_per_sm repetitions; never the P4.3 cross-campaign CV

within_campaign_flops_per_cycle_per_sm_i.basis: P2.4's count of retained flops_per_cycle_per_sm repetitions outside its Tukey IQR fences; diagnostic only, with no sample removal

within_campaign_iqr_flagged_count.basis: the closed unit's own count of retained repetitions outside its Tukey IQR fences; diagnostic only, because no flagged observation was removed

within_campaign_sample_count.basis: the closed unit's own retained repetition count for this configuration

within_campaign_stability_review.basis: the closed unit's own within-campaign stability diagnostic (CV > 5% inside one campaign); a diagnostic only, it never filtered a sample

evidence_taxonomy.cross_campaign_statistics: every mean, median, stdev_sample, cross_campaign_cv_percent, minimum, and maximum in this bundle is a cross_campaign_descriptive_statistic over exactly 3 campaign-level values, whatever the class of the underlying quantity

statistical_policy.cross_campaign_cv_effect: a review diagnostic about agreement between campaigns; it never excludes a campaign, never changes a result, and never replaces a closed unit's own within-campaign stability review
statistical_policy.within_campaign_diagnostics: each reported configuration preserves the closed unit's own sample count, CV, stability review, Tukey-IQR flagged count, profile SM-clock status, resolved-diagnostic count, surprising-value flag, and Nsight Compute diagnostic flags where those fields exist upstream; all remain per campaign, in the frozen order, under source-diagnostic names
statistical_policy.ratio_policy: ratios are computed inside each campaign and only then summarized; a ratio is never formed from two aggregates
statistical_policy.outlier_policy: no observation and no campaign is ever removed
statistical_policy.confidence_intervals: within-campaign intervals are preserved as provenance only; no cross-campaign interval is bootstrapped from 3 campaigns
statistical_policy.precision: full precision is retained during computation; decimals are applied only at serialization

taxonomy_definition.measured_source_observation: a quantity an instrument recorded directly during the campaign, described as measured only where the closed upstream protocol supports that description
taxonomy_definition.within_campaign_derived_estimate: a deterministic quantity computed inside one campaign from measured inputs and validated constants; reproducible, but not itself measured
taxonomy_definition.cross_campaign_descriptive_statistic: a descriptive statistic P4.3 computed over exactly three campaign-level values; it describes agreement between campaigns, never a new measurement
taxonomy_definition.modeled_estimate: a quantity produced by applying a model or a unit conversion to a derived estimate; its status as a model is always stated
taxonomy_definition.interpretation: a reading of the evidence, phrased as consistent-with rather than as a causal claim
taxonomy_definition.unavailable_from_collected_evidence: a question the collected evidence cannot answer; reported as such instead of being filled in
taxonomy_definition.source_diagnostic: a trust signal the closed unit recorded about its own measurement; preserved verbatim and never converted into a result
